name: Phenomorphan
summary: Phenomorphan is an opioid analgesic. It is not currently used in medicine, but has similar side-effects to other opiates, which include itching, nausea and respiratory depression.

pharmacology.text: Phenomorphan is a highly potent drug due to the N-phenethyl group, which boosts affinity to the μ-opioid receptor, and so phenomorphan is around 10x more potent than levorphanol, which is itself 6-8x the potency of morphine.

uses.text: It is not currently used in medicine, but has similar side-effects to other opiates, which include itching, nausea and respiratory depression.

summaryZh: 非諾啡烷（英語：Phenomorphan，也稱為羥苯乙嗎喃）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C24H29NO，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. As a very potent opioid it carries a high risk of overdose.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。作為藥效極強的鴉片類藥物，它的過量風險很高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。作为药效极强的鸦片类药物，它的过量风险很高。

fact.en: Like other N-phenethyl opioids, it is far stronger than the parent molecule, because that larger group fits the receptor much better than a methyl group does.
fact.zh: 與其他 N-苯乙基鴉片類一樣，它比母體分子強得多，因為這個較大的基團比甲基更貼合受體。
fact.zhHans: 与其他 N-苯乙基鸦片类一样，它比母体分子强得多，因为这个较大的基团比甲基更贴合受体。
